original_packet.prompt:
REFERENCES (attached, in this order):
1. The image to edit (the approved previous level). Edit it; do not redraw it.

Light the windmill from inside: the small arched wooden door now
lets a warm candle-amber light through, a soft amber glow along the
thin seam around the door and in its upper arch, as if a lamp
burned inside, a little brighter toward the top of the arch. The
door keeps its exact shape, panels and knob. Only the door's seam and
upper arch change: the stone, the cap, the sails and the step keep
their exact day colors (the app adds the glow around the door).

KEEP: everything not named above stays exactly the same as in the
attached image: every existing part, its shape, color, position and size,
the canvas, the camera, the light and the painting style. Do not zoom out
or reframe: if a new part does not fit, make the new part smaller, never
the existing ones. Outside the new parts, the result must line up with
the attached image pixel for pixel.

AVOID: opening the door, a new window, light rays, a glow outside the door's frame, light on the stones or the step, blown yellow-white highlights, text.

LIGHT (hour: day, layer: subject). Bright, clear, toy-like.
Paint this under the clear daylight cell: key light #FFF6EC from the upper left, soft cool fill #BFD6EE, a faint rim #FFE9C9 on the far edge. The game relights and grades this sprite for the hour, so keep the light neutral and readable. Do NOT paint a cast shadow on the ground or onto a background: only soft contact occlusion where forms touch.
VALUES: haze is depth, not a filter over the whole frame. The subject plane uses the full value range: true darks in the deepest recesses (eyes, door, soil, gaps between forms) and clean highlights. Contrast falls only with distance from the subject. A soft, gentle look means soft local colour and soft edges, never lifted blacks, a milky veil or a grey-white wash.
This is the SUBJECT plane: no atmosphere at all, the strongest contrast and the deepest darks in the picture.

Output: one image, transparent background PNG, square 1024 x 1024.
